_about: How the lenses walk an organization's controlled assets. When a footprint is larger than the asset limit, the limit is shared out a type at a time in turn, so it samples every kind of asset. follow_last lists OAM asset types that take their turn but whose own relations a lens follows only after every other controlled asset's: they are numerous and mostly lead back to assets the lens already follows (a URL sits on a name already in the footprint), so following them first would spend reads before the names, certificates and networks that show more outside parties. They are still followed while the limits allow. Add values here, not in Go code.
